newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares fall prey to correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares fall prey to correction.

text.p: Slovenian shares snapped a three-day winning streak on Tuesday, falling prey to a technical correction on what traders said was meagre volume.
Traders hope next week's listing of petrol trader Petrol may kick some life back into the market.
Petrol is one of Slovenia's five largest companies.
* The SBI index eased 7.48 points to 1,314.87.
* Overall nine shares fell, five rose and one was flat, while 12 were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active, firming 0.37 percent to 24,200 tolars on volume of 239 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439.
